title: Accessories
description: Our Accessories collection feature a selection of soft goods, and other exclusive, limited run Viberg releases.

title: Autumn / Winter '24 Drop 1
description: The AW24 collection is inspired by the idea of 'uniforms for the contemporary worker.' By incorporating traditional colors from the US Army and reflecting our 93-year legacy of serving the industrial workforce, this collection is designed to prioritize functionality and utility in today's environment.

title: Autumn / Winter '24 Drop 2 Collection
description: The AW24 collection draws inspiration from the concept of 'uniforms for the modern worker.' It features traditional colors from the US Army and embodies our 93-year history of supporting the industrial workforce, with a focus on functionality and utility for today's needs.

title: Autumn / Winter '24 Drop 3
description: The AW24 collection draws inspiration from the concept of 'uniforms for the modern worker.' It features traditional colors from the US Army and embodies our 93-year history of supporting the industrial workforce, with a focus on functionality and utility for today's needs.

title: Autumn / Winter '25 - Drop 1
description: Drop 1 of our AW25 Collection introduces Alpine French Calf in Port, Malt, and Black—a finely embossed leather from one of France’s premier tanneries. Paired with a selection of classic silhouettes, this release blends heritage and innovation with Ridgeway and EVA lug soles— offering comfort, grip, and reduced weight without compromise.

title: Autumn / Winter '25 Drop 2
description:
Introducing two distinct material stories. Toast and Tobacco Waxy Commander—a robust, heavily waxed cowhide with natural weather resistance—offered in rich, evolving tones. Whiskey and Oak Kudu, sourced from antelope hide, deliver pronounced grain, tensile strength, and lasting comfort.

Built on classic silhouettes, they define a collection that balances utility with elegance.

title: Black Teacore Horsebutt Pre-order
description:
Pre-orders are now open for four new styles in Heavyweight Black Teacore Horsebutt—a release that reflects not just material, but the discipline of nearly a century of shoemaking. Two interpretations of our Stitchdown Service Boot®, along with the Engineer and N1 Boot, form this release. Each silhouette speaks to a different chapter of our history—industrial necessity, military uniformity, and modern refinement—yet all are united by the same principles of craft.
This is the essence of Viberg: building with discipline, preserving tradition, and creating footwear meant to endure for generations to come.

title: Black Waxed Flesh
description: Crafted with Horween's Black Waxed Flesh, this collection highlights our signature double-row Stitchdown construction, a hallmark of our Pacific Northwest heritage, infused with details from our vintage archives.

title: Care
description: These essential items are everything you need to extend the life of your Vibergs. The products in our Care collection are designed to preserve, restore, protect, and enhance your smooth leather and suede shoes and boots.

title: City
description:
Developed to provide function, comfort, and utility while living in an urban environment.

The City Collection reflects our ability to innovate as a brand and workshop to create a wide range of products that all share the same brand values and materials set out nearly a century ago.

title: Classic
description:
Dating back nearly 100 years, the Classic Collection is the foundation of our brand’s heritage.

This collection is a collaboration between classic shape and function, allowing these products to be worn in different environments, day in and day out.

title: Featured: Chromexcel® Service Boot®
description: Chromexcel® is a staple leather for the Viberg Service Boot®. Known for its unique pull-up, Chromexcel® has been produced by Horween for over 100 years. The recipe involves chrome and vegetable tanning and requires 89 individual steps and a minimum of 28 days to complete. The result is an incredibly durable leather with a refined & rugged finish that gets better with age.

title: Icons
description: Our family's shoemaking legacy, spanning five generations, is a testament to our enduring commitment to quality and tradition.

title: Limited Release
description: Featuring highly coveted and unique leathers, our Limited Releases are produced in small batches which showcase the highest level of craftsmanship.

title: Mahogany Hatchgrain Shell Cordovan® Collection
description: This exclusive collection features three iconic styles — Navvy™, Uplands and Bristol — crafted from Horween's Mahogany Hatchgrain Shell Cordovan®. Built on our timeless 1940 and 1905 Lasts, these three make-ups blend classic style with functional versatility.

title: Muschio & Naturale Horsebutt
description: Our newest Limited Release Collection showcases the 145 Oxford, Navvy™ Boot, and Service Boot® 2030, crafted with Maryam’s Horsebutt—a testament to our commitment to quality and tradition.

title: Natural Cypress
description: Our newest Limited Release Collection showcases the Roper, 145 Oxford and Service Boot® 2045 crafted with Horween’s Natural Cypress—a reflection of our dedication to craftsmanship and heritage.

title: Noisette Tanganiyka Collection
description: Our latest Limited Release collection is designed to transition effortlessly between environments, offering both durability and elegance for every occasion. Featuring five iconic styles: The Navvy™, Savoy, Scout, Bristol, and Bastion crafted with C.F. Stead’s Tanganiyka in Noisette.

title: Pre-order: Shell Cordovan Deadstock
description: Pre-Order is now closed.

title: Refined
description:
Our Refined Collection represents five generations of the Viberg family shoemaking tradition.

This collection celebrates iconic traditionally made silhouettes, crafted through our family’s long tradition of producing footwear made for hard work, outside. The finished product showcases sophisticated utility, featuring versatile styles that can be worn day in and day out.

title: Service Boot®
description:
The Service Boot® is our foundational product which dates back to the 1930s.

This pattern is a classic ankle derby boot which is one of the most versatile patterns available.

title: Service Boot® 1035
description: Our 1035 last is a classic round toe last that fits generously from the heel through to the ball.

title: Service Boot® 2030
description: The 2030 Last is our most popular last and is based on a Canadian military boot with a low profile and almond-shaped toe.

title: Service Boot® 2040
description: Our 2040 last, influenced by the anatomical Munson last, is designed for sustained comfort, making them ideal for those who walk extensively.

title: Service Boot® 310
description: Developed for utility and function our 310 last shares the Munson last toe bump combined with a vintage climbing boot last with heavily sprung-toe creating a unique aesthetic while giving you comfort to walk for long periods of time.

title: Service Boot® Chromexcel®
description: The Chromexcel® Stitchdown Service Boot® combines over 200 years of experience to create a truly iconic product designed to get better with age and last a lifetime of hard wear.

title: Shell Cordovan®
description: Our Shell Cordovan® collection embodies the pinnacle of craftsmanship, blending Viberg's hand-crafted footwear tradition with Horween's legacy of leather tanning expertise.

title: Spring / Summer '25
description: Shop all of our SS25 Collection. Showcasing premium leathers sourced from renowned tanneries in France and England.

title: Spring / Summer '25 Drop 1
description: Our SS25 Collection showcases versatile styles that embody our family’s five generations of boot making heritage, standing as a testament to our enduring commitment to quality and tradition.

title: Spring / Summer '25 Drop 2
description:
This drop features Chestnut and Juniper Suede, alongside the durable Urban Waxy Commander, perfect for all conditions.

Carefully crafted with our signature Stitchdown or Channeled Insole Goodyear construction, each piece reflects our dedication to timeless craftsmanship and innovation.

title: Spring / Summer '25 Drop 3
description: Drop 3 from our SS25 Collection features the refined Tobacco Janus Calf Suede and the robust, weather-resistant Antique Waxy Commander.

title: Spring / Summer '26 Pre-Season
description: Our Pre-Spring Transitional Edit introduces Alcazar French Calf, a finely printed hatch-grain leather sourced from one of France’s storied tanneries. Presented in Black, Malt, and Brandy, each shade interacts uniquely with the grain, from the depth of polished black, to the warm tobacco undertones of malt, and the burnished richness of brandy that deepens beautifully with wear.

title: Tanganiyka Collection
description: Our latest Limited Release collection is designed to transition effortlessly between environments, offering both durability and elegance for every occasion. Featuring four popular styles: The Navvy™ BCT, Navvy Cut Shoe, Chelsea, and the Side Zip crafted with C.F. Stead’s Tanganiyka in Snuff and Black.

title: Terrain
description: Developed for versatility, our Terrain Collection combines utilitarian design with industrial performance, suited for alpine trekking and outdoor exploration.

title: The City Suede Edit
description: The Sneaker and Slip-on were developed for casual wear and daily transitions—lightweight, supportive, and understated. Designed for effortless movement, the City Suede Edit features full grain calf suedes from premier tanneries in Italy and England. Available in three warm-weather suedes: Avocado, Acorn, and Peanut.

title: The Unlined Suede Edit
description: This collection delves into our long-established expertise in the art of shoe craft, featuring sleek styles and leather soles ideal for Summer weather.

title: Viberg x Studio019
description:
We’re proud to introduce a very limited collaboration between Viberg and S_019:
The Overcoat, The Peacoat & The Parka — three timeless outerwear styles designed and crafted in Italy.


Founded by longtime friends and industry veterans, Enrico (a master patternmaker and clothing technician) and Alan (with global expertise in product development and production), S_019 was built around a shared love for vintage menswear and timeless craftsmanship. Their small atelier allows for only the most limited production, with each piece reflecting their meticulous approach.

title: Viberg | Dress Shoes
description: Our Refined Dress Shoes Collection showcases our family’s five generations of shoe making heritage, standing as a testament to our enduring commitment to quality and tradition.

title: Walnut & Charcoal Cypress Collection
description: For this exclusive release, we have expertly hand-crafted iconic silhouettes using Horween's Charcoal and Walnut Cypress.

title: Wooly Chromexcel Collection
description: This exclusive Service Boot release features Wooly leather, a rarely used variation of Horween's Chromexcel. This unique leather is heavily stuffed with unrefined lanolin, also known as "wool grease," a byproduct of wool production.
